passives.name: Primordial Weapon
passives.description: (Passive Effect) Increases damage taken from Fire, Water, and Earth enemies. Inflicts Dual Attack Disabled on all enemies, and reduces Speed of Light and Dark enemies. This effect cannot be removed until the Boss is killed. Reduces damage taken from skills other than Burst Skills and Skill Chains, and reduces Weakness Gauge damage taken by [Buff_V_4086007_4_22]. Greatly reduces damage taken from Light and Dark enemies, and does not take Weakness Gauge damage.
